issues.reason: Resultatives put the per-member rule 'beside the reified result state' as its own statement at (STV 1.0 0.9), and the only place the instruction set licenses a rule nested as a conjunct is inside a SEAL — as emitted, $y is bound by neither the outer premise nor any asserted fact and the nested rule silently inherits the outer 0.9/0.9, so an unbound-variable rule is asserted as ordinary conclusion content.

gaps_confirmed: a resultative whose object is a plural group inside a clause that is itself a generic rule: the instruction set never says where the mandated per-member half goes, and it licenses a nested rule only inside a seal
new_gaps: that gap has a second horn the reviewer did not state: the literal 'beside' reading — the per-member rule at top level — drops the neap-tide condition and asserts unconditionally that every tide-pool is dry, so neither placement is licensed as written; the nearest licensed composition is a separate two-premise rule (Implication (And (Member $x neap_tide) (PartOf $y sk_pools_1)) (Member $y dry)) at (STV 1.0 0.9), which the instruction set never names for this case
defect_summary: The compliant form keeps the per-member distribution out of the conclusion and gives it its own truth value and a bound variable — as written, no placement the instruction set names works (top level over-asserts by dropping the generic's condition, nesting is unlicensed), so the licensed form would have to be the composed two-premise rule (Implication (And (Member $x neap_tide) (PartOf $y sk_pools_1)) (Member $y dry)) (STV 1.0 0.9); this is filed as a gap.
notes: Everything else matches doctrine — neap_tide fusion with its genus, tide_pool with the noun modifier suppressed, the definite plural as a top-level group constant, per-binding Skolem event and state terms, Agent on the transitive subject, resultative Patient, and 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase.
